text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters (Brunei Darussalam) Order 2006 and shall be deemed to have come into operation on 15th February 2006.

heading.en: Declaration of Brunei Darussalam as prescribed foreign country

text.en: 2. Brunei Darussalam is hereby declared as a prescribed foreign country for the purposes of Part III of the Act.
